payload: Trump melted down on Truth Social Saturday morning over a meeting Tucker Carlson, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Thomas Massie held — which had actually happened a couple of weeks earlier and wasn't secret (they posted photos and did a Tucker Carlson show segment) — calling them 'losers all,' branding Carlson a low-IQ individual who 'could barely get out of college,' Greene a 'highly neurotic young woman' who flipped to a 'liberal fool,' and Massie a failed politician and 'real jerk,' signing off 'Praise be to Allah.' The creator argues the delayed, out-of-nowhere reaction shows Trump's dementia, drawing an analogy to his own grandmother (who has dementia) confusing a year-old storm TV special for something happening live outside. His conclusion: he agrees Carlson, Greene, and Massie are weirdos and losers, but so is Trump — both camps are enemies of each other and of the viewer, so hate both sides and just enjoy watching them feud since no matter who wins they're all losers.
notes: Framed as commentary; the host openly sides against all parties ('they're all just a bunch of losers').
gaps: The claim that Trump 'has dementia' is the creator's armchair editorializing, offered as explanation for the timing, not a medical diagnosis.
